entries.english:
Letters of feud.

Duration: 1564, 1588, 1592, 1603

Contains, among other things, letters of feud issued to the lords von Rosenberg by subjects from Uiffingen, Oberschüpf, and Bofsheim, chiefly for sexual offenses.

Extent: 8 documents
